title: ENCRYPTION AND SECRETS
subtitle: Protect data on the wire and on disk, and keep the keys somewhere better than a config file.
footer: System Design, Step by Step · core concepts

blocks.text: TLS on every hop, mTLS between services, encrypted disks plus field-level encryption for the most sensitive data.
Master key never leaves the KMS; data keys encrypt data and are stored encrypted beside it. Every decrypt is checked and logged.

items: DB / storage encryption: copied files, backups
Field-level or tokenization: admins, SQL-injection dumps
In a secrets manager, never in code or images
Fetched at runtime with service identity
Scan repos; revoke leaks at once
Rotation re-wraps data keys, not data
User passwords: slow salted hash, not encryption

blocks.text: "All traffic is TLS with mTLS from the mesh. Card numbers are tokenized into a vault encrypted with per-merchant KMS data keys, and service credentials come from the secrets manager and rotate daily."
